findings.classification: Static source/config facts; explicit arithmetic examples are inference.
findings.prerequisite: Ordinary job availability is gated by the serialized UnlockHobby resource IDs and required skill counts; Digger/Planter/Zamphoney/Mech have explicit item unlock exceptions, including prior level/experience retention.
findings.decision: Click an unlocked inactive job to reserve the current job state's TimeBlocks, or click an active job to stop it.
findings.real_cost_time: No cash activation fee. Reserved blocks compete with hobbies, dates, event allocations and main QPiddy deductions. Active dt completes cycles; state supplies cycle duration, income and cycles to promotion. Job gilding multiplies cash output, not cycle/experience speed.
findings.mutation: Completed cycles add income to Cash and TotalIncome, and add experience until promotion. Promotion increments Level, clears experience, switches salary/duration and attempts to replace the job's prior allocation with the next level's allocation.
findings.downstream_consumer: The larger cash pool pays gifts/dates; job level can satisfy relationship requirements. TotalIncome and job changes feed achievements.
findings.failure_aftermath: Insufficient initial blocks opens the time-block dialog and leaves the job inactive. Generic promotion allocation failure keeps the earned promotion but disables the job and releases its allocation. Actual supplied main jobs have equal or decreasing block costs, so a rising-cost promotion is not a supplied main-table case. The PerformUpdate while loop does not recheck IsActive after DisableJob, so an allocation failure does not clearly stop remaining dt within that already-running call. Pausing retains currentTime; state stores level/experience/partial time/active/gilding.

concrete_rows.data: Burger has no hobby unlock; Burger Flipper pays 10 per 5 game seconds, reserves 3 blocks, promotes after 24 cycles to Bun Toaster paying 12 per 5 seconds with 3 blocks. At base multiplier, uninterrupted fresh state takes 120 seconds and earns 240 before promotion. Final Beef Chief pays30 per5s and uses2 blocks.

Funny2 AND Suave2 unlock Restaurant. Busser reserves4 blocks, pays24 per8s and needs75 cycles. Work-at-Restaurant level0 requirement means some earned experience or higher level, not mere unlocking or toggling.

Angst20 AND Wisdom20; Artist starts7 blocks,30/60s,144 cycles. Iconoclast final uses1 block and15000/60s.

Suzu unlock exception; Seed Sower requires35 blocks and pays55555/333s. LoadStates copies TimeBlocks as a field initializer, so JobState optional constructor Min25 does not cap this actual35-block value.

Initial Wizard uses25 blocks, pays1 per315360s and needs69 cycles; final Sorcerer Supremo uses5 blocks, pays serialized381469726.5625/16146.432s, cast to381469726 by runtime. Gilding raises money but does not reduce these durations.

facts: Increasing relationship Love adds (clamped target level + 1) * per-girl StatsModel.PrestigePerLevel to PendingPrestige; resets current date/gift counters. PrestigePerLevel is parsed from CSV column 11.
Base achievements add 0.05 pending prestige and optional diamonds; PES skips these achievement grants.

Reset UI displays pending gain at least zero and clipped to total 2048; soft Prestige writes max(old boost, old boost + pending), clears pending and resets runtime/current progress, then saves and reloads scene 0. It does not cap this write locally; Init caps loaded boost to 2048.

Soft reset deletes current money, hobby-unlock mask, girls-unlocked mask, current girl, 12 skill prefs; every loaded girl loses Love/hearts/current dates/gifts and selected outfit plus lifetime dates/gifts. LifetimeOutfits is retained. Jobs lose active/time/lock/XP/level while retaining Gilded; hobbies lose active/time while retaining gild multiplier count. Achievement, diamonds, purchased boost/time and inventory prefs are not deleted by this soft reset body.

Paid SkipReset applies min(2048,current + pending), invokes HandleReset and writes boost without clearing relationship/job/hobby progress. No pending-clear appears in this consumer; HandleReset only dispatches Reset achievement check. Record this observed difference without asserting bug or intent.

SkipReset default cost is 30, overridden by catalog item ending .skipreset. Purchase goes through current-session verification and user confirmation; affordability is rechecked on Pay before subtracting premium currency and calling consumer. Insufficient balance opens currency purchase and does not call success. PES default purchase overload selects event currency.

Hard ResetAll resets lifetime counters/diamonds/purchased boost/reset boost/achievements, calls global DeleteAll, then restores settings, owned inventory bitmask/awarded flags, saved NutakuItems2019, CompletedEvents, GameStateIds; Darya ownership initializes 50 diamonds. Current entitlement inventory is reapplied instead of erased.

A whole decompiled-tree symbol search found the only gameplay PendingPrestige clear in GameState.Prestige349; reviewed Changed listeners only display tutorial/store text. Paid SkipReset consumer1686–1689 does not clear pending, and Save/Load preserve pending via GameStatePendingMultiplier. This is static evidence only, not a repeated-purchase test or exploit instruction.
failure_aftermath: Reset bodies mutate/delete prefs before final Save and scene reload; no rollback/transaction boundary is visible in these methods. PlayerPrefs.Save attempts Steam export, writes dirty values to Unity PlayerPrefs, saves and clears dirty; Steam export catches/logs exceptions, while these reset callers contain no failure recovery.
No live save, transaction or failure behavior was exercised.

facts: Base uses DateTime.Now. PES requires cached server-time validity and uses DateTime.Now minus server offset. PES invalid time marks Initialized=false and shows PES Offline popup. Server cache refreshes when missing or more than 15 minutes old; remote GetTime failure stores default DateTime.

Saved GameStateDate is local now in base, lastTime in PES. Invalid/zero saved binary timestamp falls back to now. Elapsed wall seconds clamp negative to 0 and durations of 7 days or more to 604800 seconds; TotalTime adds floored minutes.

GetBoosts returns wall seconds * purchasedMultiplier and deletes stale GameStateBoost2EndTime for positive seconds. Offline UpdateProgress adds reset TimeMultiplier but suppresses PurchasedAdMultiplier to avoid multiplying purchased boost twice. PES with Timeline>0 also applies TimeWarp.GetMultiplier in that suppressed branch.

All current FrameUpdates receive PerformUpdate; cash/skill/hearts deltas are measured for popup. No earnings delta means base promotion rather than earnings popup. Popup describes 7-day base bank cap.
limits: Consumer-specific job/hobby/heart/date behavior is not reviewed by this family; those current FrameUpdates are independent mechanics.
Server connection/config availability and actual elapsed/save results remain untested.

configuration.subject: installed daily task costs and timed rewards
selected Sep-Nov2026 installed LTE schedule rows

facts: LTE CheckEvent runs only in base game, gates on valid cached server time and loaded Universe, then picks event where server-adjusted UTC is strictly between configured start and end. These installed rows are config evidence, not a confirmed live schedule.

Daily tasks save server-adjusted start ticks, Complete and Claimed separately. Start checks free time blocks; incomplete started tasks reserve their configured blocks. Their timer uses real server-adjusted time instead of purchased/reset speed. Backward time moves DateStart to current ticks. Completion releases the time block requirement; claim sets Claimed before dispatching rewards and updates UI in a Save callback.

The first of three tasks per day is the event-token task; UpdateDayIcons counts claimed day tokens. Reaching TokenRequirement claims main reward. Pay-to-finish costs max(0,FinishCost-CostPerToken*tokens), disabled if equivalent reward is already owned; confirmed purchase marks enough daily token tasks complete/claimed, claims event and saves.

Installed daily examples: token task0 is1second with0blocks; task3 grants1diamond for4blocks/20min; task5 grants+3reset for4blocks/20min; task8 advances hobbies60min for5blocks/10min; task14 advances jobs60min for3blocks/10min; task11 grants1purchased block for12blocks/1hour.

Task reward consumers grant mapped cash amounts, diamonds, event tokens, hobby/job skips, capped additive reset boost, full progress timeskips or purchased time blocks. Cash table indexes2/3/4/5/7 ->500/7500/1500000/750000000/15000000000.

Event claim marks CompletedEvents bitmap globally with ignorePes=true, queues save, sends merged LTE completion bitmap to server, then applies outfits/new-girl unlock/associated inventory locally. LTE completion and daily task keys are not deleted by base soft-reset body. NewGirl entitlement can be inferred by GirlModel.StoreLTE from completed LTE data.

CompletedEvents is merged with server cached bitmap by separate reconciliation; local completed bits are retained even when MarkLTEComplete server call fails. MarkLTEComplete only updates its server cache on success and catches exceptions.
failure_aftermath: Invalid server time returns without starting/selecting LTE; lack of free blocks opens timeblock purchase rather than starting.
LTE reward/state mutation precedes async server synchronization; no rollback is visible for sync failure.
ClaimTask stores Claimed before local reward and Save callback; no task-specific transaction rollback is present. Save callbacks depend on dirty Save reaching completion.

facts: SwitchToPes loads a separate ParallelUniverse of event resources/gifts/hobbies/dates/jobs/stats/girls/goals; saves base StoreState before setting Universe.PES=true, resets runtime collections and loads portal/party-selection scene. DisablePES saves the event state before switching flag/prefix back to base and rebuilding portal. Returning is separate from prestige.

PES PlayerPrefs writes/reads/deletes are prefixed by ActivePES.Id unless ignorePes=true; null active fallback is pes30. This separates money, event diamonds/currency, skills, girl progress, jobs, purchased boost and time blocks. Global BlayfapAwardedItems, participation and CompletedEvents explicitly ignore PES.

Goals are sorted and checked sequentially using the first missing bitmap bit; only its satisfied requirement becomes _pendingClaim. Claim refuses a set bit. Money/timeblocks/eventcurrency/goal-speedboost/timeskip consumers modify active event state. Goal speedboost multiplies event TimeMultiplier and writes it.

girl/ticket/deluxewedding/animated/bunnyoutfit/valentine/unique rewards require UpdateEventBitmap server grant. It locks reward choice, waits for response, caches returned inventory ItemIDs/Items, then sets local Goals bitmap and processes claim. Failure unlocks choice and shows Reward Claim Error without setting local goal bit. Achievement participation writes global PlayfabParticipation.

An already-owned Girl reward becomes100Tickets using a saved per-event per-goal payout decision. GingerWasabi is explicitly excluded from this swap. Ticket rewards require server inventory consumption; they are not simply a local event-currency add.

Durable awarded item ids serialize globally as a sorted base64 string and SaveFileVersion1; loading supports older bitarray save format. Main-game outfit detection uses ignorePes reads; event reward grants return through shared inventory/base consumers rather than copying event money/skills/jobs to base.

An event countdown at EndTime invokes DisablePES. CleanUpActivePes retains loaded/last10 event IDs and recently seen event namespaces (<10days by absolute time), deletes other loaded pref keys starting pes except Goals. It does not prove all old Unity persisted keys were loaded or removed.

Event schedule/start/end/starter/finish IDs/goals version and ticket-booth policy use PESData supplied to LoadPes; local PesData config defines assets/theme/currency/text. GoalsVersion defaults to Goals.csv but may be overridden remotely. Installed payload does not establish an active event or entitlement.
failure_aftermath: Missing root bundle throws or yields early; missing PesData.json or shared asset bundle yields with IsPesLoaded false. SwitchToPes has no visible rollback of its initialization guard after an exception.
Server-granted goal failure leaves claim bit unset and permits retry. Pure local goal consumers set bitmap before payout and queue save afterwards, with no transaction rollback visible.
Actual return/save/cache/server reconciliation was not executed.

findings.title: ordinary gate and two-click progression
findings.prerequisite: Cassie unlocks at Suave 0; target 1 requires 50 hearts and $35 MoneyConsume. Mio unlocks at TechSavvy 1; target 1 requires 150 hearts and Suave 3. All nine target rows for both were read.
findings.decision: Meet all AND gates and the heart threshold. The first accept displays the follow-up; the second advances. These stage lines confirm a linear transition, rather than offer answer branches.
findings.cost_and_time: Advance spends only MoneyConsume, DiamondConsume and PrestigeConsume. Cassie spends her initial $35; her next $100 requirement is a retained balance check.
findings.mutation: Love increments, resets ReceivedDates and four gift/date stage counters, and adds (new Love + 1) times PrestigePerLevel to pending prestige. OnClickAccept clears hearts below Lover. Follow-up is temporary and clears on selection/load.
findings.consumer: The next target row changes requirements and stage dialogue. Ordinary gifts open at Love 2 and dates at Love 4. Album milestones occur at Love 4/7/9; Cassie advances the tutorial and the game checks phone unlocks.
findings.failure_interruption_aftermath: No requirements means false except the selected Eva case; no current selection also returns false. OnClickAccept reaches its unconditional heart-clearing block even after a failed gate recheck. This is an unexercised source edge.

findings.title: favorite training and other Lovers feed affection
findings.prerequisite: The girl has been met and her favorite skill is above 0. Actual favorites are Cassie Buff, Mio TechSavvy, Pamu Badass, Dark One Angst, and QPernikiss Tenderness.
findings.decision: Train that skill or talk, gift, or date while meeting the separate stage requirements.
findings.cost_and_time: Passive gain is dt times skill level divided by 30, or by 3 in PES. Talk pays floor((20 + favorite level squared)^(1 + Lover count / 6.5)), doubled in PES. Cooldowns are talk 10, poke 3, and gift 30 simulation seconds, or 15 for PES gifts.
findings.mutation: InteractionBox pays hearts immediately and caps them to the remaining target. Overflow fills the threshold and negative underflow floors to 1. Lover receives 0 hearts.
findings.consumer: Favorite training improves passive and talk payoff; other Lovers increase the talk exponent. Unused hearts do not carry into the next stage.
findings.failure_interruption_aftermath: Phone waits use unscaled real time while GameState.UpdateProgress boosts simulation dt. Passive SetHearts differs from the Hearts property in lifetime HeartCount accounting.

findings.title: gifts/dates feed matching stage counts and remembered album
findings.prerequisite: Ordinary gifts require Love 2 and dates Love 4. Cassie target 5 requires 3000 hearts, HandLotion 1, Motivation 5, and MoonlightStroll 1.
findings.decision: Buy with cash or confirm the diamond alternative. Closing a date records its type; a gift updates counts only for matching current-stage requirements.
findings.cost_and_time: Moonlight costs $1000, gives 600 hearts, reserves 3 blocks, and lasts 20 simulation seconds. Movie: $1m, 300000 hearts, 6 blocks, 160 seconds. Sightseeing: $100k, 40000 hearts, 5 blocks, 80 seconds. Beach: $10000, 5000 hearts, 4 blocks, 40 seconds. A 1-diamond date calls OnDate(0), avoiding block reservation while retaining duration. Shell costs $350 for 26 hearts; HandLotion costs $2300 for 139.

findings.consumer: The same specific count evaluators gate the next stage. Full Memory Album later requires earlier existing girls at Lover with all four LifetimeDates flags. Advancing resets stage counters but retains the ordinary lifetime date flags.
findings.failure_interruption_aftermath: Cash shortage blocks purchase; free-block shortage offers a time purchase. OnDate rejects a busy date or insufficient blocks, but cash was already deducted before checking its return value. OnClose lacks an elapsed-time guard; normal UI waits for completion. Missing portrait hides the image while the timer remains. No runtime failure reproduction.
